Lab Safety Rules

Follow these rules to stay safe in the science lab.

Closed Toed Shoes

Protects your feet from spills and broken glass.

Tie Hair Back

Keeps hair away from flames and chemicals.

Waft, Do Not Smell

Fan fumes toward you instead of smelling directly.

No Horseplay

No rough housing. Stay focused and careful.

No Eating or Drinking

Never eat or drink in the lab area.

Never Drink Chemicals

Chemicals are not safe to taste or drink, ever.

Wear Goggles

Protect your eyes at all times during experiments.

No Food in the Lab

Keep all food out of the lab space.

No Broken Glassware

Never use cracked or broken glass equipment.

Follow Instructions

Always follow your teacher's directions closely.
